device_entry.description: 用于开发和测试的虚拟调试通信端口，可模拟连接开启与关闭、缓冲区数据读写以及简单的回显处理，常用于验证实验室软件中的通信流程和数据收发逻辑。
device_entry.description_en: A virtual debug communication port used for development and testing. It simulates opening and closing a connection, buffered data read/write operations, and simple echo-style processing for validating laboratory communication workflows and data transfer logic.
